replies.author: scolton
replies.body:
The staff is currently looking into the issue; I will keep you updated on possible sources of error and how/when it will be fixed.

It seems that Avicus might be shutdown temporarily for repairs.  The suspected cause is that the downgrade to 1.7 revealed code that no longer works with Minecraft 1.7 and we will work hard to repair it.
